desc: Implement ordered residue invariant comparison (ones modulo X, zeros modulo Y) and pass sample tests.
Brute-force validate the invariant for small N/X/Y against BFS; if it fails, switch to a linear canonical normalization fallback.
Ensure O(N) time/memory and handle edge cases X=1, Y=1, X+Y>N, all zeros/ones, large N.
Fallback only if needed: design an amortized-linear run-level normalizer (event-driven, not naive quadratic) and compare normal forms.
